analysis.scope: Landing-union-only audit; inherited keys read for combined context and hash/value continuity, not claimed as a fresh full linguistic audit. Identical shared values reused across the two heads.
analysis.accuracy_idiom_register_glossary: bạn or omitted pronouns remain consistent. luồng/luồng trò chuyện and câu trả lời distinguish thread from reply; cảm xúc denotes a message reaction, biểu tượng cảm xúc its emoji, and hình ảnh an attachment. lịch/lên lịch remains the scheduling term. Short action labels use plain verbs; reply time uses lúc, correctly matching a localized clock value. No calque or new glossary conflict found in the joined terms.
analysis.placeholders: Every message parsed from exact source/target bytes; every target ICU branch retains source argument names/types, pound tokens, offsets, styles and markup-token multiset. No date/number skeleton or markup alteration found. replies.count preserves count; replies.last preserves time. Locale-specific plural categories checked separately.
analysis.overflow: Character counts are screening observations, not pixel measurements or findings. Picker is w-80/max viewport width; search is a full-width input, categories are icons with title/aria text, all/categories/choose are accessible labels. Thread title is visible. Native rendering and pseudo-localization not performed.
